title: A-B pair at separation 2, at rest, to T = 0.8: K_B(A) to 1% at the P-0022 domain edge
pitch: Two particles, one A and one B, at rest at separation 2.0 on a horizontal line, sampled to T = 0.8. Under the P-0022 law the separation falls to 0.45 at T = 0.8. The end separation changes by about 0.2 to 0.26 per unit change in K_B(A), so the endpoint and the full trajectory should pin K_B(A) to a few percent, far tighter than any review bar can test. A result far from K_B(A) = 10.59 would show the constant-K claim fails near contact, and K_B(A) = 10.59 within 2 percent would support it. Tracker noise 0.05 per coordinate. Pair-law domain test, not a multi-body test.
